generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original tileable top-down albedo texture for a hand-painted native 3D meadow heightfield, not a background illustration.

Input image roles, in order:
1. The concept illustration: extract ONLY the beautiful dry-brush meadow surface language and its smoky olive-gray, gray ochre and warm bone-paper palette. Do not reproduce the girl, blue road, rocks, flowers, hills, sky, camera or composition.
2. Nomadic Tribe real website screenshot: reference for deliberate small directional drawn marks, uneven ink/paint rhythm and authored large-vs-small detail hierarchy; do not copy birds, captions, UI or blue palette.
3. Kaizen real website screenshot: reference for translucent gouache layering, fine short grass stroke field, and quiet warm light. Do not copy the purple palette, giant flowers, horizon, captions or UI.
4. Wayfinder real website screenshot: reference for sparse short linear meadow blades grouped into irregular grass bands, with quiet bare-earth clearings between; do not copy characters, trees, stones, flowers, yellow leaf ring, UI or isometric perspective.

Create ONE SQUARE flat top-down evenly lit surface swatch that fills the entire image edge to edge. It must be plausible to tile/repeat across a 16 meter wide native 3D ground mesh. It must be an albedo image ONLY: NO perspective, horizon, sky, mountains, raised mounds, shaded relief, baked shadows or object lighting, vignette, border, text, UI or watermark.

The ground needs genuine illustrated meadow articulation rather than old stained paper or camouflage. Use a softly varied base of muted smoky olive-gray (#aaa993), pale gray ochre (#c7b99b) and warm chalky bone-paper (#ddd4bf); small denser grass bands can reach subdued gray-olive (#8f927b) but must not become dark black details. Several broad asymmetrical gently interlocking washed color zones, without visible repeating circular blobs, large soft stains or outlined patches. At least half the image reads as quiet warm soil/paper with only subtle brush grain.

Across roughly one third of the area, arrange dispersed irregular bands of tiny visible hand-painted grass marks: thin short diagonal strokes, tapering needles, occasional paired strokes and tiny scumbled dabs, tilted in varied directions, with intermittent gaps and several nested scales. A visible blade should be roughly 3–10 pixels long in a ~1024 pixel tile; denser patches vary in density instead of forming identical repeated tufts. A few subdued dry straw colored strokes are allowed, no saturated yellows. Grass needs the elegant dry-brush flecked material of the concept slopes, with broken edges and translucent overlapping strokes. The 720 pixel web view should still read as painted meadow, not just beige blotches.

This is an original illustration surface texture. Keep contrast controlled but visibly more articulated than a blank paper wash: no photorealism, aerial photography, game terrain material, stock noise, uniform allover hair lines, regular icon repetitions, ornamental pattern, thick agave leaves, bushes, individual big objects, road or path. Avoid the existing texture's oversized camouflage-like scumbles. Seamless edges in both axes, no center composition, no identifiable motif. Full opaque background.
generations.reason_not_selected: Grass articulation works, but initial output was too honey-yellow and locally contrasty.

generations.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: original opaque square tileable albedo for a hand-painted native meadow heightfield.
Input roles: Image 1 is the edit target (the newly generated meadow surface). Image 2 is the approved concept illustration and palette reference only. Images 3, 4 and 5 are real Nomadic Tribe, Kaizen and Wayfinder website screenshots respectively: material authorship and sparse drawn stroke rhythm references only, never copy their scene contents, characters or UI.

Make ONE precise change to Image 1: cool, desaturate and soften its yellow/ochre-heavy palette into the smoky subdued gray-olive and warm pale-paper meadow colors of Image 2. Keep its top-down grass-band layout, irregular small diagonal blade strokes, broken dry-brush edges, quiet bare soil areas, surface-only composition and opaque square aspect ratio. Maintain enough blade articulation to see illustrated grasses at a 720px website view. Do not turn it into plain paper.

Palette targets: overall muted warm gray-olive around #b9b9a4, quiet bare soil around #d6cfbd, sparse cooler olive strokes around #939b87 and only a few dry bone colored highlights around #d7cfb4. The target image should have about half its present saturation, 65–70 percent of its present contrast, and very little honey-yellow. Bright or very dark specks should disappear into muted paint. Preserve hue variation between pale soil and subdued green grass. No purple field.

The result remains a tileable TOP-DOWN flat material albedo: no hills, sky, perspective, horizon, road, girl, objects, flowers, trees, captions, UI, vignette, frame, baked shadows or baked lighting. No photographic grass texture. Do not copy any whole reference scene. No other compositional change. Deliver one original-resolution raw PNG.

visual_inspection.method: Builtin view_image of source references and generated raw outputs; generated output also displayed inline.
visual_inspection.content: Opaque square top-down flat painted meadow surface, with gray-olive grass streak bands and warm pale-soil gaps. No horizon, road, person, stone, flower, caption or baked object shadow.
visual_inspection.limitations: Bands occupy more than the requested one third in parts of the raw output; directional rhythm is somewhat diagonal. Generated edges are not pixel-exact seamless. No web integration screenshot or design-score claim is made by this asset task.

implementation_guidance.recommended_wrap: MirroredRepeatWrapping or a single broad UV field; regular RepeatWrapping edge seams require actual runtime inspection.
implementation_guidance.palette: Subdued smoky olive-gray and gray ochre, warm pale paper soil; keep any vertex/shader tint neutral or slightly cool.
implementation_guidance.caution: Do not shrink to 3–5 meter repeated tiles, add yellow saturation, use as an entire world background, or rely on the bitmap for geometry, story objects, lighting or interaction.
